title: Roll late against developed orange
description: Roll late against developed orange. Late jail is protection from built orange with thin cash. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: I'll try my luck with the dice and see if I can roll doubles.
